text:
maria-support: heads up — customer 'AcmeAnalytics' reporting repeated timeouts (504) and sporadic 502s from hosted inference endpoint /v1/hosted-gen since ~2026-03-16 09:12 UTC. They hit a batch of requests and then got long tail timeouts. request_id: req-8f3a2b9c. Customer says their requests hang ~25-35s then 504. Posting sample curl and logs below. anyone available? :eyes:
jordan-oncall: I'm oncall, jumping in. Can you paste the exact request-id header they sent and region? Also any pattern (same model/route)?
maria-support: request-id in their payload header: x-request-id: req-8f3a2b9c. Region: us-west-2. Route: /v1/hosted-gen. Model: redwood-large-v1 (pinned). Batch size typical 8-12 tokens (they're doing small prompts but many concurrent). They attached this minimal repro curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.prod/v1/hosted-gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "x-request-id: req-8f3a2b9c" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"Summarize the article"}'
```
Logs (customer-provided): ```
[2026-03-16T09:11:58Z] request=req-8f3a2b9c routed->gateway-usw2
[2026-03-16T09:12:23Z] gateway->upstream status=502 upstream=req-8f3a2b9c error="upstream reset"
[2026-03-16T09:12:23Z] gateway->client status=502 request=req-8f3a2b9c
[2026-03-16T09:12:58Z] gateway->upstream status=504 upstream=req-8f3a2b9c error="upstream timeout"
```
:sos:
sara-sre: checking infra logs now. I see a backlog spike on the batcher pool for redwood-large-v1 in us-west-2 around 09:11:40-09:12:30 — queue depth jumped from ~120 -> 950. A bunch of inference runtime pods reported high KV cache rehydration latencies and OOM-kill retries. Attaching a quick grep from gateway logs: ```
2026-03-16T09:11:42Z gateway INFO enqueue request=req-8f3a2b9c queue_size=312
2026-03-16T09:11:57Z gateway WARN upstream-reset request=req-8f3a2b9c upstream=runtime-12
2026-03-16T09:12:20Z gateway ERROR upstream-timeout request=req-8f3a2b9c
```
eve-eng: possible suspects: 1) model variant memory pressure (recent quantization rollout on redwood-large-v1?), 2) batcher contention from a noisy tenant, 3) circuit-breaker thresholds misfiring when KV cache misses spike. I can pull runtime traces if you want me to repro.
jordan-oncall: please do a quick repro against a canary pool. Eve, can you run this stress script against canary to see if we replicate the queue growth? Use header x-test-mode: canary.
eve-eng: running now, posting results in 2m.
ken-product: customer reported ~50 requests failed across their cluster, asking for ETA and mitigation. We should prioritize a short mitigation for them and follow with postmortem and long-term fixes. SLA note: they are on paid Dedicated trial but using hosted endpoint pinned to model — high priority.
sara-sre: immediate mitigation options: 
- route this customer's traffic to a warm fallback model variant (redwood-large-v1-64q) with lower memory but validated outputs. (cheap and fast)
- temporarily bump gateway upstream timeouts from 30s -> 60s for this route while we investigate. (risk: longer blocking)
- drain and rebuild a few runtime nodes that show OOMs.
Which do we pick? :thinking_face:
maria-support: customer prefers a short mitigation now — fallback model or routing is fine if outputs match closely. They want minimal rework.
jordan-oncall: let's do fallback routing to -64q for this customer and increase circuit-breaker limit slightly. Eve, can you patch routing policy to route x-customer-id: acme -> variant -64q and restart the route? I'll open a rollback param if it causes degradations.
eve-eng: routing change applied to canary; now pushing to prod for acme only. monitor for 2m.
deploy-bot: routing-rule apply success: rule-id rr-20260316-1 -> target: redwood-large-v1-64q (acme).
sara-sre: monitoring metrics — queue depth for this customer's shard dropped from ~480 -> 40 within 40s. Upstream errors for req-8f3a2b9c show resolved. :thumbsup:
maria-support: customer confirmed reduced errors and acceptable quality for their prompts. They want a follow-up DM with RCA and permanent fix ETA.
ken-product: thanks team. Please capture action items below.
sara-sre: ACTIONS: 
- SRE-821: investigate root cause of KV cache rehydration spike and OOMs on runtime-12 (assigned to sara-sre).
- ENG-942: add limit and backpressure telemetry per-tenant to detect noisy tenants earlier (assigned to eve-eng).
- OPS-503: add a small routing playbook to fall back to quantized variant for pinned models (ken-product to own runbook).
- MON-1201: alert tweak to fire when queue_size > 200 for >1m for any model-shard (sara-sre).
- COMM-67: customer follow-up note & summary (maria-support).
jordan-oncall: filing incident ticket and tagging postmortem owners. Will schedule 1h follow-up tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
eve-eng: repro run on canary replicated the queue spike when we flood small concurrent requests with KV-cache cold start. Adding a micro-optimization patch to async KV prefetch. Will open PR.
maria-support: booked customer check-in in 30m to confirm good status. Thanks all. :hands_together:
ken-product: adding this thread to the postmortem doc and will summarize the immediate mitigation we applied.
sara-sre: closing war-room stage — keep thread open for postmortem notes and link to incident ticket INC-20260316-ACME.
maria-support: noted. I'll DM the customer and attach the incident ticket.
summary: Customer AcmeAnalytics experienced 502/504s and long timeouts on hosted endpoint due to batcher queue spike and runtime KV cache rehydration causing OOMs; team applied routing fallback to quantized variant, increased observability, and listed action items for SRE/ENG/OPS.
